clinician.trajectory_summary: 16-year-old male presented with bleeding manifestations (diffuse petechial rash, bilateral subconjunctival hemorrhages, haemoptysis) and constitutional B symptoms (fatigue, bone pain, night sweats). Initial laboratory studies showed leukocytosis (WBC 101 × 10^9/L), anemia (hemoglobin 106 g/L), severe thrombocytopenia (platelets 12 × 10^9/L), and peripheral blood smear with 75% leukemic blasts. He was initially diagnosed with Burkitt leukemia and treated with standard institutional therapy; retrospective whole-genome sequencing of the archived diagnostic Burkitt leukemia blood sample showed no evidence of the ETV6-ABL1 fusion. Seven months after completion of therapy, bone marrow aspirate revealed marked hypercellularity with significant eosinophilia and absence of elevated blasts consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm (MPN). Whole-genome sequencing and RNAseq of this MPN bone marrow sample identified a dispersed duplication event of approximately 600 kb from ABL1-PRRC2B (9q34) inserted into the ETV6 locus (12p13), confirming an ETV6-ABL1 fusion transcript with an intact, in-frame ABL tyrosine kinase domain. The patient was subsequently started on imatinib (tyrosine kinase inhibitor) and underwent a 10/10 matched unrelated hematopoietic stem cell transplant.

key_supporting_evidence.claim: 16-year-old male presented with diffuse petechial rash, bilateral subconjunctival hemorrhages, haemoptysis, fatigue, bone pain, and night sweats
CBC showed leukocytosis (WBC 101 × 10^9/L), anemia (hemoglobin 106 g/L), and severe thrombocytopenia (platelets 12 × 10^9/L)
Peripheral blood smear showed 75% leukemic blasts
Initial diagnosis of Burkitt leukemia with treatment initiated per institutional standard
Whole-genome sequencing of archived Burkitt leukemia diagnostic sample showed no evidence of ETV6-ABL1 fusion
Bone marrow aspirate 7 months post-therapy showed marked hypercellularity with significant eosinophilia and absence of elevated blasts consistent with MPN
Whole-genome sequencing identified dispersed duplication of ~600 kb from ABL1-PRRC2B (9q34) inserted into ETV6 locus (12p13)
RNAseq confirmed ETV6-ABL1 fusion transcript with intact, in-frame ABL tyrosine kinase domain
Patient treated with imatinib (tyrosine kinase inhibitor) and underwent 10/10 matched unrelated hematopoietic stem cell transplant

ruled_out_or_less_likely_alternatives.alternative: Burkitt leukemia as the definitive diagnosis
ruled_out_or_less_likely_alternatives.basis: Whole-genome sequencing of the initial diagnostic sample showed no evidence of ETV6-ABL1 fusion, and the MPN with ETV6-ABL1 fusion represented a distinct clonal process from the initial Burkitt leukemia

remaining_uncertainties: Whether the ETV6-ABL1 fusion was present in the 7-month post-therapy bone marrow sample or identified at a subsequent progression event
Flow cytometry immunophenotyping results to further characterize the MPN lineage
Physical examination findings including organomegaly or lymphadenopathy
Coagulation study results despite active bleeding manifestations
Clinical outcome and response following hematopoietic stem cell transplant
